states.EPHEMERAL_ACTION_ARTIFACT: GitHub Actions artifact with finite retention; not durable custody
states.TRANSFER_PENDING_VERIFICATION: Bytes were sent to a candidate durable store but destination readback is incomplete
states.ACQUIRED_DURABLE: Destination object ID, byte size and SHA-256 were independently read back and match the source manifest
states.LINK_ONLY: No redistributable bytes are held; stable source navigation only
states.PRIVATE_STUDY_ONLY: Bytes are held under a non-public research boundary
states.PUBLICATION_ELIGIBLE: Separate item-level identity, rights, credit and route decisions are complete
